headline: Rhode Island State Police arrest man sought in Boston kidnapping case
dek: Troopers stopped a vehicle in East Greenwich and arrested a 27-year-old Lawrence man after Massachusetts State Police issued an alert tied to a Boston incident.
body: Rhode Island State Police arrested a Lawrence, Massachusetts, man in East Greenwich after Massachusetts authorities issued an alert for a vehicle connected to a Boston kidnapping investigation.

Troopers stopped the vehicle on New London Turnpike at about 9:15 p.m. Saturday and arrested Ysael Lara Gonzalez, 27, the Rhode Island State Police said in a Sunday release. Police said the investigation was conducted with the Boston Police Department.

Gonzalez was charged with domestic-violence kidnapping, domestic-violence felony assault, disorderly conduct and two counts of possessing a prohibited weapon other than a firearm, according to the state police release. The charges are allegations, and the defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Police transported Gonzalez to the Rhode Island State Police’s Wickford Barracks for processing and held him pending arraignment in Third District Court. The release did not provide additional details about the Boston incident.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Rhode Island State Police arrest Boston kidnapping suspect
seoDescription: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 27-year-old Lawrence man in East Greenwich in connection with a Boston kidnapping investigation.
